make_empty_intermediate_tensors for this model has exactly two fields: 'hidden_states','residual' (torch.zeros(batch,hidden_size)). No topk/aux state crosses PP stages.

One int32 topk_indices_buffer [max_num_batched_tokens,index_topk] per rank when is_v32, shared to all local layers; a skip_topk layer skips its indexer and reuses 'the topk_tokens buffer written by a previous layer in the same pass'.
